item.title: Easy Navigation with Vim Arglist
item.description:
Introduction

In the days of fancy plugins super (or over?) charging vim to make it look like a fully fledged IDE, I sometimes like to go back to the basics and (re)discover how vim often already has something builtin to do things, albeit maybe in a slightly different way.

Before LSP was a thing, tags were already there to help us navigate a codebase and we also have the :compiler command to run linters and populate the quickfix list with errors. Before fuzzy finders were all the rage, we had :edit, :find and the argument list (:h arglist).
